See how risks are classified by the Domain Factors Taxonomy. The Domain Taxonomy of AI Risks adapted from Weidinger (2021) classifies risks into 7 AI risk domains: (1) Discrimination & Toxicity, (2) Privacy & Security, (3) Misinformation, (4) Malicious Actors & Misuse, (5) Human-Computer Interaction, (6) Socioeconomic & Environmental, and (7) AI System Safety, Failures, & Limitations.
This sheet shows the total percentage of papers and risks which relate to each of our domain factors. For more detail please see our report.
